summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by MasterBeef Group announcing a preliminary, non-binding franchise arrangement to introduce a Thai tea beverage and dessert brand into Hong Kong and Macau. No definitive agreement has been signed; the filing describes a strategic expansion plan with a target of three outlets within 24 months. There are no specific deal terms, prices, or financial details disclosed. As a non-binding preliminary discussion of a franchise, this does not constitute a special situation such as an acquisition or strategic review. The filing is an ordinary business update with no M&A transaction or shareholder vote required, thus mapped as 'None'.
